name: Synthesizer Labship — the station line's trigger is fired, not a static effect
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). "2+ | At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one other target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 2/2 and gains flying" was read as a static global effect with a garbage filter, and could not be fired: extractTriggeredAbilities did not look past the "N+ | " station label. It now does. Fired at two charge counters and pointed at Sol Ring, Sol Ring is a 2/2 flying artifact creature; Mind Stone is left alone.
